subtitle: Lesson 5 · Reading only the bytes you need

steps.label: CSV
steps.sub: Row by row, read it all

steps.label: Parquet
steps.sub: Column by column, skip the rest

code:
df.to_parquet(
    "ticks.parquet",
    engine="pyarrow",
    compression="snappy",
)
# pyarrow is the bridge: pandas,
# Polars, and disk all share Arrow
caption: Arrow is why moving data between pandas, Polars, and disk is cheap.

code:
pd.read_parquet(
    "ticks.parquet",
    columns=["date", "price"],
    filters=[("ticker", "==", "AAPL")],
)
# skips other columns' blocks AND
# row groups that can't match
caption: Never read bytes you don't need -- CSV can't do either trick.

code:
df.to_parquet("a.parquet",
              compression="snappy")
# fast, modest compression

df.to_parquet("b.parquet",
              compression="zstd")
# slower write, smaller file
caption: snappy favors speed; zstd favors smaller files. Both decompress fast.

subtitle: The Arrow-native engine built to read Parquet lazily.
